name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard.fairygui
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Keyboard (FairyGUI Binding)
description:
FairyGUI GTextInput keyboard binding package for GameFrameX OperationKeyboard. GTextInputKeyboardBinder subscribes onFocusIn / onFocusOut to establish and release the keyboard session, with input events assigning text and confirm / complete dispatching onSubmit, mirroring the native path. A DontDestroyOnLoad auto-binder polls Stage.inst.focus at low frequency, so panels need zero changes; com.gameframex.unity.fairygui.unity presence is probed via versionDefines and the binder is stripped when absent. This is the official keyboard path after FairyGUI 6.0.0 removed the inline WeChat / Douyin bridges. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard 的 FairyGUI GTextInput 键盘绑定包。GTextInputKeyboardBinder 订阅 onFocusIn / onFocusOut 建立与释放键盘会话，输入事件回写文本、确认 / 完成派发 onSubmit，与原生路径一致。DontDestroyOnLoad 自举自动挂载器低频轮询 Stage.inst.focus，面板零改动；com.gameframex.unity.fairygui.unity 经 versionDefines 探测，未安装时绑定器代码被裁剪。该包是 FairyGUI 6.0.0 去除内置微信 / 抖音桥接后的官方键盘路径。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
